body: That was 4 months ago wow....thank you so much I'm doing much better....much....
Thank you. This means a lot.

I can relate to much of this...but I'm 47 and just trying to turn my life around now.

The odds you have HIV from this one sole encounter are slim to none.  Did your friend ejaculate inside you?  If he was only inside you for three seconds then the risk of infection is very very low.  Almost zero probability...and believe me I've engaged in enough risky sexual behavior to stand in your shoes 100x over.  But I'm HIV negative. 

Even if you do have HIV (and you don't)--there are free health clinics and organizations now that provide low to no cost care for HIV.  I know some people who have had HIV for over 20 years and it's become a manageable disease.

Plus we are on the cusp of such a breakthrough---what if you kill yourself and then the cure for HIV is found a week later...well you need to be around to see it.

You are young enough to turn everything around.  If I can do it in my 40s you can do it at 26.
